item.title: Vienam bans unskippable ads
item.description:
📝 As Phụ Nữ reports, Vietnam recently announced Decree No. Additionally, the decree requires platforms to implement clear and straightforward ways for users to close ads with just one interaction. False or vague symbols designed to confuse viewers are forbidden.
🔗 Read more: https://saigoneer.com/vietnam-news/28652-vienam-bans-unskippable-ads,-requires-skip-button-to-appear-after-5-seconds

item.title: Launch HN: Tamarind Bio (YC W24) – AI Inference Provider for Drug Discovery
item.description:
📝 Tamarind is an inference provider for AI drug discovery, serving models like AlphaFold. Biopharma companies use our library of leading open-source models to design new medicines computationally. Some of them used to extract proteins from animal blood before replacing that process with using AI to generate proteins on Tamarind.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46515777

item.title: Show HN: Jax-JS, array library in JavaScript targeting WebGPU
item.description:
📝 jax-js runs completely in the browser by generating fast WebGPU and Wasm kernels. JavaScript doesn’t even have a fast, native integer data type. Here, instead of Nvidia CUDA, we write pure JavaScript to generate WebAssembly and WebGPU kernels.
🔗 Read more: https://ss.ekzhang.com/p/jax-js-an-ml-library-for-the-web

item.title: Why Big Companies Keep Failing: The Stack Fallacy (2016)
item.description:
📝 Stack fallacy is the mistaken belief that it is trivial to build the layer above yours. You can build things higher up the stack. It is just that often it is not clear what to build.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2016/01/18/why-big-companies-keep-failing-the-stack-fallacy/
